channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Meme coin Non-Playable Shiba is up 15-fold since Tuesday and 33% in a day, all in one Uniswap pool
item.description: NPS, a Shiba-themed Ethereum token whose CoinGecko price history starts on Tuesday, November 24, hit a record on Thursday morning and sits on CoinGecko's trending list. Every trade CoinGecko tracks runs through a single Uniswap pool.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $451.6 million Wednesday, the seventh straight outflow day, $2.56 billion in all
item.description: The final count for Wednesday, November 25, is almost four times the early read. Ether funds lost $68.5 million, and U.S. markets are closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving, so the next flow figure comes Friday.

item.title: World Liberty's USD1 shrank $1.04 billion in 23 days, most of it on Solana and Ethereum
item.description: DefiLlama data show the dollar stablecoin fell from $3.89 billion on November 3 to $2.85 billion, a 26.7% drop, while its price stayed at $1. The shrinking stopped on November 23.

item.title: 10 sharks sold $20 million of USDD in a day and bought back $14.6 million, but the peg held
item.description: Ten large wallets tracked by DeepSea ended $5.45 million net sellers of the Tron dollar token. Tronscan shows USDD being redeemed and burned the same morning, while the price stayed near $0.999.

item.title: Sharks traded $23.5 million of Venice's VVV in a day, five times the day before, as it jumped 11%
item.description: Eight large wallets tracked by DeepSea bought $12.58 million of the AI token on Base and sold $10.9 million. One shark we checked on BaseScan added 110,143 VVV since Wednesday.

item.title: 13 sharks bought $1.34 million of Worldcoin's WLD in a day, five days after its record low
item.description: Large wallets tracked by DeepSea bought nearly five times as much WLD on Optimism as they sold. The token rose 6.8% but is still down 43% in a month.

item.title: Binance hack wallet logged a $6.6 million 'sale' but has signed nothing since October 31
item.description: DeepSea logged one $6.61 million sale by the wallet Etherscan labels "Binance Hot Wallet Exploiter 2". Etherscan shows it still holds $2.08 billion of tokens and has signed no transaction in 25 days.

item.title: Shark wallets sold $7.14 million of gold token PAXG as it bounced 1.8%, a day after buying
item.description: On Tuesday, two shark wallets bought PAXG as it fell. In the latest 24 hours, four sold $7.14 million of the gold token and bought back only $0.53 million.

item.title: ETF & Whale Flows, November 26: bitcoin ETF outflows hit seven straight days, $2.56 billion
item.description: A net $451.6 million left U.S. spot bitcoin funds on Wednesday, November 25, in CoinMarketCap's final figures, the seventh outflow day in a row. On chain, a $41.1 million wstETH "buy" in DeepSea's table was a plain transfer on Etherscan.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin bounced 6.6% to $61,097, but ETF outflows hit a seventh day
item.description: Bitcoin touched $61,097 on Wednesday evening and ether briefly passed $1,700. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs still logged a seventh straight day of outflows. We checked five viral claims.

item.title: Bullpen breach: $2.57 million left old beta accounts and now sits as 42 BTC
item.description: An on-chain trace shows the funds moving from Solana to Arbitrum and then into four Bitcoin addresses, where they have not moved. Bullpen says it took a test service offline and only early beta accounts were hit.

item.title: Pieverse jumps 32% in a day to $3.85 after a slide from its $5.33 record
item.description: PIEVERSE fell to about $2.87 after its November 22 peak, then climbed back on Wednesday. It is trending on CoinGecko, and South Korea's Upbit leads the trading.

item.title: A ransomware "recovery" firm said it never paid hackers. DOJ says it paid $6,000 in bitcoin and billed $13,260
item.description: A federal grand jury in Rhode Island indicted the co-founder of a Florida data recovery company on three counts of wire fraud. Prosecutors say the firm secretly paid ransoms and kept the markup, and an FBI sting caught it.

item.title: Fidelity files for a Chainlink fund on Nasdaq, ticker FLNK, with no staking and the fee blank
item.description: Fidelity's S-1 for a spot LINK fund landed on SEC EDGAR at 1:48 p.m. ET on November 25. Three custodians would hold the coins, the fund will not stake, and the fee and ticker are still placeholders.

item.title: Monad's MON hits a second record low in a day, $0.00914, as trading tops its market value
item.description: MON fell 8.5% below Tuesday morning's record low, bounced, then slipped back under one cent. Its 24-hour volume more than tripled, led by a Uniswap pool on Monad itself.

item.title: USDC jumped $717 million in 17 hours, then gave back $254 million as USDT sat flat
item.description: Circle's USDC grew fast on Monday, then shrank as bitcoin slid under $60,000. Tether's USDT stayed inside a $141 million band for 72 hours.

item.title: Gold token PAXG fell 3.2%, more than bitcoin, as two sharks bought $1.41 million
item.description: PAXG dropped to $3,507, 37.6% below its January record, as gold fell harder than bitcoin. Two large wallets were net buyers of about $1 million on Ethereum in a day.

item.title: BlackRock's IBIT shed 70 million shares since September and now holds 752,597 bitcoin
item.description: The biggest U.S. bitcoin fund's share count fell 5.0% from September 30 to November 23, iShares' own files show. Its net assets fell by a third, mostly because bitcoin's price fell.

item.title: Six sharks netted $1.07 million of Venice's VVV in a day as the AI token slid 2.8%
item.description: Six large wallets tracked by DeepSea bought $2.73 million of the private-AI token on Base and sold $1.66 million, while VVV fell 2.8% and bitcoin fell 2.3%.

item.title: Hong Kong's HKMA switches on a blockchain bond platform that settles 24 hours a day
item.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched the CMU Digital Asset Platform on November 25, 2026. It moves bonds from issuance to redemption on a shared ledger, settles in multiple currencies around the clock, and is meant to link up with regulated stablecoins later.

item.title: Rumor vs record: ANSEM really fell 53% in 15 minutes, but the hack story is unproven
item.description: We checked seven claims that spread on Tuesday, November 24, against CoinGecko, company releases and the Justice Department. Three hold up, two are close but off, and two cannot be confirmed from the record we could reach.

item.title: DOJ charges over 800 in its biggest scam sweep; one task force restrained $1.08 billion in crypto
item.description: The Justice Department said Tuesday it has charged more than 800 defendants in over 400 scam cases since March. One task force alone has traced and restrained $1,082,260,156.82 in crypto taken from U.S. victims and pulled down 700 fake crypto investment sites.

item.title: WLFI hit a record low as 4 sharks sold $12.1 million and bought $9.8 million in a day
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour table shows heavy two-way shark trading in World Liberty Financial's token, equal to about two-thirds of its CoinGecko volume. The token is down 87.8% from its high.

item.title: HYPE fell 8.6% in a day, but its $539 million in Hyperliquid bets tops ether's
item.description: Hyperliquid's own token slid all Tuesday to $58.79, three times bitcoin's drop. The money in open HYPE futures on its home exchange barely moved, and longs were still paying shorts.

item.title: 105 sharks lost $23.5 million in a week. One Avalanche trade alone cost $2.29 million
item.description: The weekly loss in DeepSea's live feed is 50% bigger than on November 15. Only 24 of 105 big wallets closed the week in profit, making $415,000 together.

item.title: Big Time jumped 67% a day after its record low, with Upbit taking 60% of the trading
item.description: The gaming token rose from $0.0041 to about $0.0068 late Tuesday, most of it in a 47% jump in one quarter hour after 11 p.m. ET. Volume hit roughly ten times a normal day, and one Korean exchange, Upbit, carried 60% of it.

item.title: ETF & Whale Flows, November 25: bitcoin ETFs' outflow run hits six days and $2.11 billion
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds lost $234.5 million on Tuesday, November 24, a sixth straight outflow day, in CoinMarketCap's updated data. The first read at 12:35 a.m. ET showed only $59.2 million.

item.title: Monad's MON fell 27% from its overnight high to a record low under one cent
item.description: MON dropped from $0.0138 at 1:35 a.m. ET to $0.00999 at 10:03 a.m. ET on Tuesday, November 24, its lowest price ever. Volume nearly doubled as bitcoin slid 4.8%.

item.title: U.S. files to keep $1.1 billion of Binance hack USDC. Over $2.9 billion is now frozen, seized or returned
item.description: The Justice Department said on Monday, November 23, that it filed a civil forfeiture claim for more than $1.1 billion in Circle's USDC stolen in the October 29 Binance hack, which it attributes to North Korean cyber actors.

item.title: Bitcoin fell under $60K from Monday's $64,446 high, yet USDC supply grew $583 million
item.description: Bitcoin spiked to $64,446 on Monday morning, then slid to $59,798 by early Tuesday, November 24. Hyperliquid's bitcoin bets barely moved, and the six largest dollar stablecoins grew by $687 million in a day.

item.title: LayerZero's ZRO fell 16% in a day as volume tripled to $91.6 million, with no stated cause
item.description: ZRO dropped from $1.27 on Monday morning to $1.04 by early Tuesday, November 24. Trading volume tripled, but LayerZero has posted no news that explains the slide, and no new unlock is on DefiLlama's schedule.

item.title: A shark 'sold' $220 million of staked ether. The chain shows a transfer to one wallet
item.description: DeepSea logged $115.7 million of weETH and $103.8 million of wstETH leaving one wallet. Blockscout shows no sale and no unwrap. The wallet paid down part of an Aave loan, then sent both tokens to a single address that still holds them.

item.title: One shark took in $56.7 million of RLUSD in a day, then sent $32.8 million to Binance and Bybit
item.description: DeepSea's top RLUSD line, $54.13 million bought, comes almost entirely from one wallet. Blockscout shows it working as a pipe, with dollars arriving from Bullish, OKX, Bitstamp and unlabeled wallets and leaving for exchange deposit addresses.

item.title: A shark's $45.9 million 'buy' was a loan swap that freed 410 cbBTC from Aave and Spark
item.description: DeepSea logged a shark wallet's $25.87 million of cbBTC as a buy while bitcoin slid toward $60,000. Blockscout shows no purchase. The wallet refinanced a $10 million loan and pulled its own bitcoin collateral back.

item.title: CFTC staff: exchanges and clearinghouses can count bitcoin at 80% toward their reserves
item.description: A new CFTC staff letter says U.S. futures exchanges, swap platforms and clearinghouses may count bitcoin, ether and payment stablecoins toward the 12 months of operating costs they must hold, after haircuts of 20% and 2%. Crypto still cannot fill the cash part of the cushion.

item.title: Bitwise's Avalanche ETF (BAVA) files its prospectus: 0.34% fee, 12% staking cut
item.description: The SEC filing for the Bitwise Avalanche ETF names NYSE Arca, Coinbase as AVAX custodian and a plan to stake some or all of the fund's AVAX.

item.title: Rumor vs record: 4 of 6 crash claims hold up, led by bitcoin ETFs' $3.46 billion November outflow
item.description: A list of crash-week numbers spread widely over the weekend. We checked six lines against CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko: four are true, while the IBIT record and the 60-day Coinbase premium could not be checked.

item.title: ETF & Whale Flows, November 24: $1.88 billion left bitcoin ETFs in five straight days
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday, November 23, their fifth straight outflow day, in final CoinMarketCap data. Ether funds lost $84.9 million. Corrected: an earlier version used a preliminary Monday figure.

item.title: Pearl hit a record $2.48 on Monday, then slipped 8% by early evening
item.description: The AI mining coin climbed about 21% from midnight ET to a new high at 4:55 p.m. ET, just above its October record, while bitcoin went nowhere. By 7:10 p.m. ET it was back at $2.29.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin buys 17 ounces of gold, still 39% above its March low
item.description: Bitcoin has lost 15% against gold since November 1, and gold has held up better all year. But bitcoin was cheaper in gold in March, and gold itself is 36% below its record. We checked five claims.

item.title: 6 senators ask Treasury to give state stablecoin issuers the same shield as federal applicants
item.description: Treasury's draft rule gives federal applicants with a waiver up to 12 months of cover once the stablecoin law takes effect. Three Republicans and three Democrats say state-licensed issuers deserve the same.

item.title: Singapore MAS DPT license: PSA rules, capital, fees and process
item.description: Crypto firms serving customers in Singapore need a Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) license for digital payment token (DPT) services under the Payment Services Act. They apply as a standard or major payment institution, with base capital of S$100,000 or S$250,000.

item.title: The week's top shark made $1.27 million, then bought $396,000 of EVAA as it fell 43%
item.description: Only 23 of 99 sharks DeepSea tracks made money this week, and 71 lost. The best of them, Hold8771, spent about $592,000 in seven minutes on Sunday morning, on EVAA and on bitcoin.

item.title: Rumor vs record: XRP Ledger users fell 15%, not 60%. Four more weekend claims checked
item.description: A headline that the XRP Ledger lost 60% of its users spread overnight. XRPSCAN's counts show the drop only if you compare a record day with a day that is not over. We checked it and four other viral weekend claims.

item.title: WASTED memecoin rose 247% in two days, but its trading volume is down 98% from the peak
item.description: The Ethereum token tops CoinGecko's trending list on Sunday. Its record came on Friday. Daily trading volume, near $49.7 million on its first day in CoinGecko's data, has shrunk to $880,000.

item.title: XRP Ledger payments doubled to 1.19 million a day in November, even as XRP fell 30%
item.description: XRPSCAN's ledger counts show twice as many payments per day as in mid-October, and nearly four times the fees burned. But the busiest week is behind it, and U.S. XRP funds have not had an inflow day since October 29.

item.title: Crypto exchange license by country: UAE, Singapore, EU, UK, Hong Kong, US
item.description: Every major market has its own crypto exchange license: VARA in Dubai, MAS in Singapore, MiCA in the EU, FCA registration in the UK, the SFC regime in Hong Kong and FinCEN plus state licenses in the US. Each regulator publishes a register you can check.

item.title: Pieverse sets a record $3.92 as its market value tops $1 billion
item.description: PIEVERSE jumped about 10% in its last hour to a new high early Sunday, beating the $3.64 record from November 18. It is up about 103% in a week.

item.title: Venice (VVV) jumped 25% in a day to about $25, four times bitcoin's 6% gain
item.description: The private-AI token climbed from about $20.10 to $25.06 between 1 a.m. ET Saturday and 1 a.m. ET Sunday, November 22. Coinbase carried the most trading, and VVV is still about 27% below its September record.

item.title: Treehouse's 23.1 million TREE airdrop closes Wednesday; unclaimed tokens go to its treasury
item.description: Season 2 of Treehouse's airdrop set aside 23.1 million TREE, 2.31% of supply, and the claim window ends at 2:00 a.m. ET on November 25. The pot is worth about $667,000 at Sunday's price, with TREE 98% below its record.
